nodes.description: Public owner address stored in Ownable; written from msg.sender in constructor and reassigned by transferOwnership.
External zombieToken contract instance at fixed address used for minting rewards.
External zombieMain contract instance used for owner, role, star, color and dna queries.
Array of Area structs holding star limits, role requirements, team counters, revenue and duration.
Mapping of token id to Zombie struct holding readyTime, notAtHome flag and undeadsTime counter.
Mapping of team hash to Team struct holding zombies, owner, award time, charge flag and block number.
Library function multiplying two uint256 with an assertion guarding overflow.
Library function performing truncated integer division.
Library function subtracting two uint256 after asserting b is less than or equal to a.
Library function adding two uint256 and asserting the result did not wrap around.
Constructor that sets owner to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that validates a new owner address and transfers ownership.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal owner before executing the guarded body.
Entry point starting an invasion: validates area limits, locks zombies, builds teamHash and registers a new team.
Entry point settling a team invasion: computes outcome from star and undead counts then mints rewards or applies penalties.
Owner-only function appending a new Area struct to the areas array.
Owner-only function setting the isOpen flag of an area to false.
External call zombietoken.mint executed before the team charge flag and area team counter are updated, enabling reentrancy.
Raw multiplication and division computing dieNumber on totalStar and totalUndeadsTime without SafeMath, susceptible to overflow.
Use of block.timestamp (now) for readyTime, awardTime gates and pseudo-random seed generation that miners can influence.
Caller address used for ownership assignment, authorization checks and team ownership.
Block timestamp accessed through now, used in cooldown checks, award timing and hashing.
Area index parameter of startInvasion selecting the target Area struct.
Array of zombie token ids passed into startInvasion and stored in the team.
Team hash parameter of awardInvation selecting the Team struct to settle.
Address parameter of transferOwnership assigned to the owner state variable.
Locally accumulated hash seeded from block.blockhash and extended with now, area and zombie dna.
Accumulated star total of the team zombies read from zombiemain.seeZombieStar.
Computed threshold value compared against a keccak256 derived pseudo-random number to decide win or lose.
Memory copy of teams[_teamId].Zombies iterated over during award settlement.
Loop counter used in awardInvation, implicitly resolved to a storage slot because it is undeclared.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the untrusted caller is written directly into the owner state variable in the constructor.
startInvasion passes msg.sender into zombiemain.checkAllOwner through onlyOwnerOf to authorize zombie ownership.
awardInvation requires teams[_teamId].Owner to equal msg.sender before settlement.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
addArea is reachable only when msg.sender satisfies the onlyOwner modifier.
closeArea is reachable only when msg.sender equals owner.
block.timestamp is used for the require(now > readyTime) gate and to write new readyTime values.
block.timestamp gates awardTime and is mixed into the keccak256 outcome seed.
The untrusted timestamp flows into the timestamp dependency unsafe operation.
readyTime in the zombies mapping is derived from now and later gated against now.
awardInvation performs the external mint call before setting isCharge and decrementing the area team counter.
A malicious zombietoken.mint implementation can re-enter awardInvation while the team is still uncharged.
Re-entrant control can re-read or re-settle the teams mapping entry before isCharge is written.
Areas TotalTeamCount is decremented only after the external call returns, allowing repeated settlement.
startInvasion sets notAtHome and readyTime for each zombie entry in the zombies mapping.
startInvasion stores a freshly constructed Team struct keyed by teamHash.
startInvasion queries zombiemain for ownership, role and dna data.
awardInvation queries zombiemain.seeZombieStar while accumulating totalStar.
awardInvation invokes zombietoken.mint to pay the area revenue on a winning outcome.
awardInvation performs unchecked multiplication and division to derive dieNumber.
The isCharge flag is written after the external mint call, leaving a window for repeated settlement.
The _areaId parameter indexes the areas array throughout startInvasion.
The _zombieId array drives ownership checks and zombie state updates in startInvasion.
The _teamId parameter selects the Team struct settled by awardInvation.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state variable.
The accumulated teamHash is used as the mapping key when creating the Team.
totalStar feeds directly into the unchecked dieNumber arithmetic.
dieNumber is the unsafe arithmetic result compared against the pseudo-random value.
The zb memory copy of team zombies is iterated for reward and penalty loops.
The undeclared loop counter i controls iteration over the team zombie array.
Timestamp derived cooldown logic influences startInvasion eligibility.
Timestamp derived award gate and randomness influence awardInvation outcome.
The constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender as the initial owner.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to the validated new owner.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: _areaId is a transient index parameter whose meaning is fully captured by startInvasion.
_zombieId is a transient array parameter consumed entirely inside startInvasion.
_teamId is a transient lookup parameter consumed entirely inside awardInvation.
newOwner only exists to feed the transferOwnership state transition.
teamHash is an intermediate hash local to startInvasion that becomes the teams mapping key.
totalStar is an accumulator that only matters as an operand of the unsafe arithmetic in awardInvation.
dieNumber is the direct output of the unsafe arithmetic used for the win or lose decision.
zb is a local alias of the team zombie array iterated inside awardInvation.
The implicit loop counter i only exists to drive iteration inside awardInvation.
